description: Duplicated-rule class at its source (issues #640, #466). Held-out (written before any run, never reworded after one, scored apart): reviewer-role-restates-skill (a worker step restating the error rule the diff changes in the notes-cli skill; `Verdict: blocking` and an `Owner:` line for that skill listing agents/worker.md). Writer cases (#466): supervisor-call-restated-spec, a supervisor's spec call on greet-times while docs/specs/usage.spec.html and README.md restate the old rule; graded on the branch touching both specs. Held-out: supervisor-call-restated-readme (the same fixture, other wording; graded on greet.spec.html and README.md touched). implementer-help-owned-rule (held-out; gh906's shape): a ticket changing a rule `app list --help` owns, which README.md restates; graded on the branch touching src/app.py and README.md and an `Owner:` line for src/app.py.
